👉VIDEO INTRODUCTION:
Doston, 2006 mein ek aisi movie release hui jisne poore diamond market mein tehelka macha diya!! This was a movie called Blood Diamond!!
Aur is movie ke baad, duniya mein natural diamonds ke khilaaf ek andolan shuru hua. Aur issi andolan se duniya mein ek aur lehar aayi—yeh lehar thi lab-grown diamonds ki!!
Doston, jis heere ko pehnne ke liye pehle log 2 se 6 lakh rupaye kharch karte the, aaj wahi same quality aur wahi same chamak wala heera sirf 10 se 20 hazaar mein mil raha hai! Toh achanak se yeh 100 saal purana diamond empire taash ke patton ki tarah girne laga!! Look at this—1 carat diamond ke average prices 7,000 dollars se girkar ab 4,000 dollars tak pahunch chuke hain, aur wahi 1 carat ka lab-grown diamond aaj market mein 900 dollars mein mil raha hai!!

Toh sawaal yeh hai ki lab-grown diamond aur natural diamond mein aakhir kya farak hai? Is Blood Diamond movie se diamond market ko dhakka kyun laga? Lab-grown diamonds achanak se 2 lakh ke diamond ko 10,000 rupaye mein kaise bech paa rahe hain? Aur is diamond war mein kya natural diamonds khatam hone wale hain?
